chronicle.text: Moubudam tied fiber and fiber together with fiber and was left with something to carry things in: the first carrier.
Thigai tied wood and wood together with fiber and was left with something that floats and carries someone across water: the first raft.
Roule tied a carrier and fiber together with fiber and was left with something heavy on a handle: the first club.
A hungry year: 3 people starved.
Sozais struck flint with stone and was left with a sharp edge: the first blade.
Helaithail tied a club and fiber together with fiber and was left with something warm to wear: the first wrap.
Zodain tied a bundle they had tied and a blade together with fiber and was left with a sharp point on a long shaft: the first spear.
